---
title: "penguins"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: penguins-info
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(palmerpenguins)
head(penguins)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-penguins
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Bill length vs. depth across penguin species"
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(
    bill_length_mm,
    bill_depth_mm,
    colour = species
  )
) +
  geom_point()
```

As shown in @fig-penguins, penguin species differ in bill morphology.
